videos.title: The impossible process of making a computer chip | The Vergecast
videos.description:
Computer chips are so utterly everywhere that we often don’t think about them at all. But we should. Gideon Lewis-Kraus, a writer and reporter, recently traveled the world attempting to figure out how chips get made. He joins the show to explain the wildly complicated, unbelievably expensive, non-stop miracle that is chip manufacturing. He also explains why no one, no matter their budget, can simply decide to become a chip giant. It’s just not that easy.

videos.title: FAA shutdown: what happened?
videos.description:
A single router upgrade may have brought US air travel to a standstill.

On November 13th, the FAA grounded flights nationwide for nearly five hours after a telecommunications failure disrupted air traffic control systems. Thousands of flights were canceled or delayed, leaving travelers stranded across the country.
